organization: Railway Recruitment Boards (RRB), Ministry of Railways
recruitment_summary: The RRB NTPC 2025-26 recruitment is a centralized drive to fill 8,868 vacancies in non-technical cadres of the Indian Railways. This cycle is split into two notifications: CEN 06/2025 for Graduates (5,810 posts) and CEN 07/2025 for Undergraduate/12th Pass candidates (3,058 posts). The process is highly competitive, utilizing a multi-stage Computer Based Test (CBT) followed by post-specific skill tests. As of April 2026, the Graduate CBT-1 has concluded, and the Undergraduate CBT-1 is imminent.

overview.Selection_Process: CBT-1, CBT-2, Typing Skill Test / CBAT, Document Verification, Medical Examination

eligibility_criteria_manual.Nationality: Citizen of India, Subject of Nepal/Bhutan, or Tibetan Refugee settled before 1962.

Educational_Qualification.Graduate: Degree from a recognized University or equivalent.
Educational_Qualification.Undergraduate: 12th (+2 Stage) or equivalent with at least 50% marks (50% not required for SC/ST/PwBD/Ex-SM).

examination_process_flow.Details: Common for all posts. 100 Questions, 90 Minutes. Qualifying in nature to shortlist 20 times the vacancies for CBT-2.
examination_process_flow.Normalization: Standard RRB formula used across multiple shifts.

examination_process_flow.Details: Separate for each Pay Level (Level 2, 3, 5, 6). 120 Questions, 90 Minutes. Scores here determine the final merit list.
examination_process_flow.Negative_Marking: 1/3rd mark deduction for every wrong answer.

examination_process_flow.CBAT: Only for Station Master/Traffic Assistant. No negative marking. Qualify in all 5 test batteries.
examination_process_flow.Typing_Test: 30 WPM in English or 25 WPM in Hindi. Qualifying only.

examination_process_flow.Details: Verification of original documents followed by a medical fitness test at Railway Hospitals.

Mathematics: Number System: Decimals, Fractions, LCM, HCF
Arithmetic: Ratio and Proportions, Percentage, Profit and Loss, Simple and Compound Interest
Time_and_Work: Time and Distance, Pipes and Cisterns
Advanced_Maths: Elementary Algebra, Geometry and Trigonometry, Elementary Statistics
General_Intelligence_and_Reasoning: Analogies: Number, Letter, and Meaningful words
Series: Completion of Number and Alphabetical series
Logical_Reasoning: Syllogism, Jumbling, Venn Diagrams, Puzzle, Data Sufficiency
Analytical: Statement-Conclusion, Decision Making, Maps, Interpretation of Graphs
General_Awareness: Current_Events: National and International importance (Last 12 months focus)
History_Geography: Indian Freedom Struggle, Physical/Social/Economic Geography of India
Science: General Science and Life Science (up to 10th CBSE)
GK_Static: Art and Culture of India, Games and Sports, Indian Economy, Space and Nuclear Programs

medical_standard_definitions.A-2: Physically fit in all respects. Distant Vision: 6/9, 6/9 without glasses. Near Vision: Sn. 0.6, 0.6 without glasses. Must pass tests for Color, Binocular, and Night Vision.
medical_standard_definitions.B-2: Distant Vision: 6/9, 6/12 with or without glasses (Power not to exceed 4D). Must pass Field of Vision test.
medical_standard_definitions.C-2: Distant Vision: 6/12, NIL with or without glasses. Near Vision: 0.6 combined with or without glasses while reading.

application_fee.Payment_Modes: Online via Net Banking, UPI, Credit/Debit Cards; Offline via SBI Challan

how_to_apply_detailed: Step 1: Registration: Visit your chosen RRB website and click 'New Registration'. Provide Name, DOB, Aadhaar, Mobile, and Email.
Step 2: Verification: OTP validation on Mobile and Email.
Step 3: Application Part I: Fill in Educational details and Community status.
Step 4: Fee Payment: Pay using the integrated payment gateway.
Step 5: Application Part II: Set post preferences (ensure medical eligibility).
Step 6: Document Upload: JPEG Photo (35x45mm), Signature, and SC/ST Certificate (if applicable for free travel pass).
Step 7: Final Submission: Review all entries and take a printout of the application.
